haikus.haiku:
Golden peaches gleam,
Warm spice swirls through the kitchen,
Sweet steam fills the air.
Happy #NationalPeachPieDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft clouds drift above
Sunlight soft kisses bright wings
Joy fills gentle hearts
Happy #BeAnAngelDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Smooth flute notes rise high,
fresh peach sweet on summer air—
joy sings in each chord.
#HappyBirthdayClaudeDebussy from @ClamBakeSanta

Paper stars glow bright
Ink rivers flow soft like dreams
Night sky hums soft tales
#HappyBirthdayRayBradbury from @ClamBakeSanta
